column1: # NVS Credentials Template for ESP32-C3 Industrial Secure WiFi Enterprise
# This template is used by the production script to generate device-specific credentials
# - DO NOT commit this file with actual passwords to Git
# - This is a TEMPLATE only - actual values should be filled by production script
# - Generated files must be encrypted before flashing to ESP32
# 2. Script fills DEVICE_ID and WIFI_PASSWORD with actual values
# 3. Script encrypts the file using nvs_partition_gen.py
# 4. Encrypted file is flashed to ESP32
# 5. Original unencrypted file is securely deleted
